text.en:
MALACAÑANG
PRESIDENTIAL DECREE No. 136 March 2, 1973
AMENDING PARAGRAPH 2, ARTICLE IV, CHAPTER I OF PART VI OF THE INTEGRATED
REORGANIZATION PLAN TO INCLUDE THE EXECUTIVE SECRETARY IN THE MEMBERSHIP OF
THE DEVELOPMENT BUDGET COORDINATION COMMITTEE
WHEREAS, since the Executive Secretary was already a member of the Presidential Development Budget
Committee (renamed Development Budget Coordination Committee in the Integrated Reorganization Plan),
for purposes of consistency and continuity, it is deemed that he retain his membership in said Committee;
WHEREAS, in addition, the Executive Secretary has already been included in the membership of the NEDA
under Presidential Decree No. 1-A as reaffirmed under Presidential Decree No. 107;
NOW, THEREFORE, I, FERDINAND E. MARCOS, President of the Philippines, by virtue of the powers
vested in me by the Constitution as Commander-in-Chief of all the Armed Forces of the Philippines, and
pursuant to Proclamation No. 1081, dated September 21, 1972, and General Order No. 1, dated September 22,
1972, as amended, do hereby order and decree that Modification of Paragraph 2, Article IV, Chapter I of Part
VI of the Integrated Reorganization Plan is hereby adopted and approved, to include the Executive Secretary
in the membership of the Development Budget Coordination Committee.
Done in the City of Manila, this 2nd day of March, in the year of Our Lord, nineteen hundred and
seventy-three.
